description: Read a text file and record it as an open buffer, with the metadata needed to write it back safely: its language id and the mtime to hand to editor::save.

path.description: Jail-relative when `shell`'s `fs.host_roots` are set, else absolute — the same path vocabulary as `shell::fs::read`.

content.description: File contents as text. Binary files are refused rather than mangled.

language.description: Monaco language id for the path, e.g. `rust`, `typescript`, `plaintext`.

mtime.description: Last-modified time, Unix seconds. Pass it back as `expected_mtime` on `editor::save` to get the conflict guard.

truncated.description: True when the file exceeded `max_file_bytes` and `content` holds only its beginning. Saving a truncated buffer back would delete the rest of the file, so `editor::save` refuses one.
